question.text: In put-call parity (C - P = S - PV(K)), which type of options must this relationship hold for?

answer.text: Both European and American options equally

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that put-call parity holds only for European options. European options can be exercised only on the expiration date, which is the condition under which the parity equation is derived. The Trap: American options can be exercised at any time on or before expiration, so the strict equality of put-call parity does not apply directly to them. Note: Exchange-traded interest rate options in India are European-style call and put options, so the put-call parity relationship is directly applicable to them.
